vision.core: authentic 80s/90s Asian banquet wedding with 1990s Japanese city pop twists
vision.approach: pragmatic like it was actually done then, with elegant modern accents for comfort
vision.modern_twist: relaxed second half with neon-lit lounge/arcade and fusion elements
vision.audience: memorable for first-timers, engaging for young guests with stylish updates

venue_zones.main_dining: 200-220 guests at 20-22 round tables with lazy Susans, stage for ceremonies; soft white walls for neon reflections
venue_zones.lounge_arcade: secondary space opening at 7:45pm with understated neon kanji signs, konbini snack spot, and lone arcade machine
venue_zones.entrance_hall: red envelope station and guestbook with subtle digital QR for app check-in
venue_zones.window_side: VIP seating or photo area overlooking hazy urban view

program_anchors: grand entrance (2 min) with subtle city pop remix
tea ceremony on stage (10-12 min) with short video montage
cake/champagne moment (3-4 min) with fusion desserts
group photo on stage (5-7 min) with nearby AR photo booth

flow.unified_start: 6:00-7:45pm all in main dining under warm amber lights
flow.lounge_opens: 7:45pm after ceremonies, with teal/pink neon glow and games

atmosphere.feeling: warm, bustling, lived-in banquet hall with serene city pop haze
atmosphere.aesthetic: venue's existing decor plus minimal red/gold touches, retro boombox centerpieces, gentle teal/pink neon washes

sensory.sound: Cantopop remixed with city pop beats, chatter, clinking dishes, karaoke duets
sensory.smell: Chinese banquet food with fusion dessert notes
sensory.visual: dim amber lighting blending into neon reflections, soft film-like haze
sensory.taste: 8-10 course traditional banquet with fusion hybrids like yuzu spritzers

memorable_elements: authentic tea ceremony with video montage
candid moments captured in retro film style
interactive app polls and photo sharing

food_specifications.style: Traditional Cantonese banquet with subtle city pop fusion twists
must_include: fusion dessert/sweet soup (e.g., matcha mochi or White Rabbit ice cream)
food_specifications.additions: konbini-style snacks in lounge (senbei crackers, ramune sodas)

essential_experience: Chinese restaurant banquet weddings with fusion elements

must_understand: Venue/food already booked—focus on hands-on coordination for everything else
